title: Payments
body: Take a deposit or the whole fee at the moment of booking.

title: Video links
body: A meeting room is created and attached as soon as a booking lands.

title: Routing forms
body: Ask two questions, then send the answer to the right person's calendar.

title: Recurring events
body: Book a weekly one-to-one for the next twelve weeks in a single pass.

title: Team pooling
body: Share the load round-robin, or find the one slot everybody has free.

title: Workflows
body: Reminders, follow-ups and surveys that send themselves on your schedule.

title: Thirty languages
body: Your booking page arrives in whichever one the visitor's browser asks for.

title: Embeds
body: Put the whole booking page inside your own site with one line of markup.
